import Mathlib

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def bubble_sort_precond (v : List Int) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  True
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def intInsertSorted (x : Int) : List Int → List Int
  | [] => [x]
  | y :: ys =>
      if x ≤ y then
        x :: y :: ys
      else
        y :: intInsertSorted x ys

def intInsertionSort : List Int → List Int
  | [] => []
  | x :: xs => intInsertSorted x (intInsertionSort xs)
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definitions
def bubble_sort (v : List Int) (h_precond : bubble_sort_precond v) : List Int :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  intInsertionSort v
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def bubble_sort_postcond (v : List Int) (result : List Int) (h_precond : bubble_sort_precond v) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  List.Sorted (· ≤ ·) result ∧ result.Perm v
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
theorem intInsertSorted_perm (x : Int) (l : List Int) :
    (intInsertSorted x l).Perm (x :: l) := by
  induction l with
  | nil =>
      simp [intInsertSorted]
  | cons y ys ih =>
      by_cases h : x ≤ y
      · simp [intInsertSorted, h]
      · simpa [intInsertSorted, h] using
          (List.Perm.cons y ih).trans (List.Perm.swap x y ys)

theorem intInsertionSort_perm (l : List Int) :
    (intInsertionSort l).Perm l := by
  induction l with
  | nil =>
      simp [intInsertionSort]
  | cons x xs ih =>
      dsimp [intInsertionSort]
      exact
        (intInsertSorted_perm x (intInsertionSort xs)).trans
          (List.Perm.cons x ih)

theorem intInsertSorted_sorted (x : Int) (l : List Int) :
    List.Sorted (· ≤ ·) l →
      List.Sorted (· ≤ ·) (intInsertSorted x l) := by
  induction l with
  | nil =>
      intro _
      simp [intInsertSorted, List.Sorted]
  | cons y ys ih =>
      intro hsorted
      have hdecomp :
          (∀ b ∈ ys, y ≤ b) ∧ List.Sorted (fun a b : Int => a ≤ b) ys := by
        simpa [List.Sorted] using hsorted
      by_cases hxy : x ≤ y
      · have hhead : ∀ z ∈ y :: ys, x ≤ z := by
          intro z hz
          simp at hz
          rcases hz with rfl | hzys
          · exact hxy
          · exact le_trans hxy (hdecomp.1 z hzys)
        have hgoal :
            (∀ z ∈ y :: ys, x ≤ z) ∧
              List.Sorted (fun a b : Int => a ≤ b) (y :: ys) :=
          ⟨hhead, hsorted⟩
        simpa [intInsertSorted, hxy, List.Sorted] using hgoal
      · have hhead : ∀ z ∈ intInsertSorted x ys, y ≤ z := by
          intro z hz
          have hz' : z ∈ x :: ys := by
            exact (intInsertSorted_perm x ys).mem_iff.mp hz
          simp at hz'
          rcases hz' with rfl | hzys
          · omega
          · exact hdecomp.1 z hzys
        have htail :
            List.Sorted (fun a b : Int => a ≤ b) (intInsertSorted x ys) :=
          ih hdecomp.2
        have hgoal :
            (∀ z ∈ intInsertSorted x ys, y ≤ z) ∧
              List.Sorted (fun a b : Int => a ≤ b) (intInsertSorted x ys) :=
          ⟨hhead, htail⟩
        simpa [intInsertSorted, hxy, List.Sorted] using hgoal

theorem intInsertionSort_sorted (l : List Int) :
    List.Sorted (· ≤ ·) (intInsertionSort l) := by
  induction l with
  | nil =>
      simp [intInsertionSort, List.Sorted]
  | cons x xs ih =>
      dsimp [intInsertionSort]
      exact intInsertSorted_sorted x (intInsertionSort xs) ih
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem bubble_sort_postcond_satisfied (v : List Int) (h_precond : bubble_sort_precond v) :
    bubble_sort_postcond v (bubble_sort v h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  dsimp [bubble_sort_postcond, bubble_sort]
  constructor
  · exact intInsertionSort_sorted v
  · exact intInsertionSort_perm v
  -- !benchmark @end proof
